hypothesis: At the pinned commit every one of the 4 ranks redundantly runs the full Newton-Schulz orthogonalization for every Muon matrix inside MuonAdamW._muon_step (compiled _muon_math). Partitioning only the Newton-Schulz stage across ranks (each rank orthogonalizes a contiguous 1/4 slice of each same-shape batch, results exchanged with one all_gather, momentum and post-NS math kept replicated) is mathematically the same update and removes ~75% of the NS compute per rank. The fresh-start ledger (fs-w65: exact numerical gate plus +5.06245% complete steps; retained in fs-w70/fs-w98/fs-w146) shows this ownership change is real and safe on the same 4-rank LNC=2 shape. With train.py's elapsed-time LR schedule, the recovered time becomes extra optimizer steps in the fixed 1800 s budget and lowers public_val_bpb (the bf16-sdpa KEEP shows +7.6% steps mapped to -0.0039 BPB at this commit).
implementation_plan: All edits confined to train.py on branch autoloop/20260922-muon-owner-ns-split-r2 from 9a4caa7b. Reference (read only, adapt names): research/scratch/fresh_start_train.py --experimental-optimizer-ownership path at the same commit. STEP 1 (static inspection, reported only as a note in the implementation summary): open class MuonAdamW; locate _muon_step and the compiled helper _muon_math it calls. Identify inside _muon_math (a) the statements up to and including the computation of the Newton-Schulz input (momentum buffer update, Nesterov blend, any pre-NS scaling/dtype cast), (b) the Newton-Schulz orthogonalization call (the routine selected by the existing plain / --compile-muon / --nki-muon precedence), and (c) every statement after it (shape-dependent scale such as sqrt(max(1, rows/cols)), second-moment normalization, LR / weight-decay application, in-place parameter update). Confirm that every rank currently runs (b) for every matrix; if work is already split by rank followed by a collective, stop and report HALT-INERT. STEP 2 (toggle): following the existing --bf16-sdpa-input pattern, add module-level USE_MUON_OWNER_COMPUTE = True with env override NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_MUON_OWNER_COMPUTE ('0' disables), argparse pair --muon-owner-compute / --no-muon-owner-compute (dest muon_owner_compute, default None -> constant), resolved in main() before the optimizer is constructed. Do NOT add it to ARCH_TOGGLE_NAMES (it does not affect forward, weights, checkpoints or evaluation). STEP 3 (split, no arithmetic change): create two new helpers next to _muon_math by moving code, not rewriting it: _muon_pre(...) contains exactly the statements of group (a) (same tensors, dtypes, scalar/tensor-LR handling, in-place momentum update) and returns the NS input for the batch; _muon_post(...) contains exactly the statements of group (c), taking the orthogonalized batch as input. Give each the same compile decorator/wrapper treatment that _muon_math currently has (if _muon_math is wrapped by torch.compile or a cached compiled callable, wrap _muon_pre and _muon_post identically; leave the NS routine's own compile/NKI selection untouched). Leave _muon_math itself in place and unchanged for the disabled path. STEP 4 (partition): in _muon_step, for each same-shape batch (or per-parameter group if the code processes matrices individually -- in that case first stack same-shape momentum-updated matrices into a batch, as fresh_start_train.py does), when USE_MUON_OWNER_COMPUTE and torch.distributed.is_available() and is_initialized() and world_size > 1 and n >= 2: (i) G = _muon_pre(...) with shape [n, *shape]; (ii) per_rank = (n + world_size - 1) // world_size; start = rank * per_rank; owned = G[start : min(start + per_rank, n)]; if owned has fewer than per_rank rows, pad by repeating G[0:1] until the local stack has static shape [per_rank, *shape] (padding values are discarded; no zero matrices are introduced so no norm guard changes); (iii) local_out = <the same NS routine the original code would call> (local_stack); (iv) gather: allocate out_all of shape [world_size, per_rank, *shape] (same dtype as local_out) and call torch.distributed.all_gather_into_tensor(out_all.view(world_size * per_rank, *shape), local_out) on the default process group; if all_gather_into_tensor is unavailable for the active backend, use torch.distributed.all_gather(list_of_world_size_tensors, local_out) and torch.stack; (v) full_out = out_all.reshape(world_size * per_rank, *shape)[:n] -- rank-order concatenation, so index k of full_out corresponds to matrix k of the batch under the contiguous mapping in (ii); (vi) _muon_post(full_out, ...) applies the unchanged post-NS math and parameter update on every rank. Perform the collective in ordinary (eager/lazy-XLA) code, not inside a torch.compile region. Batches with n < 2, the toggle off, or world_size == 1 execute the original _muon_math call exactly as today. Do not change parameter iteration order, momentum/second-moment state tensors, gradient all-reduce, clipping, --clip-after-reduce/--grad-bucket logic, AdamW/ngram-ve optimizers, schedules, model, data or evaluation code. STEP 5 (one-time equivalence check, diagnostics only): on the FIRST call of _muon_step in which the partition path runs (module-level flag so it happens once), for each partitioned batch also compute ref_out = <same NS routine>(G) on the full batch, and print on rank 0 one line 'muon_owner_check batch=<i> shape=<shape> n=<n> max_abs_diff=<float> max_abs_ref=<float>' using (full_out - ref_out).abs().max() and ref_out.abs().max() (a single .item() sync each, once). The update still uses full_out; ref_out is discarded. STEP 6 (logging): add exactly one field 'muon_owner_compute=<bool>' to the existing optimizer/sched_tricks config oneliner printed at startup. STEP 7 (static self-review in the implementation summary, no execution required): state that the diff is limited to the toggle/env/CLI resolution, the _muon_pre/_muon_post extraction (moved statements, not rewritten), the ownership/all_gather block in _muon_step, the one-time check and the one log field; state that _muon_math is unchanged and is the path taken when the toggle is off or world_size == 1; state that forward/eval code, ARCH_TOGGLE_NAMES, checkpoint format and optimizer state tensors are unchanged. Runtime verification belongs to the Operator's smoke run (abort conditions above). Launch smoke and full with the exact control launch command and environment (NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2 torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=4 train.py --num-steps 5000 --max-train-seconds 1800 --seed 42; NEURON_CC_FLAGS='--optlevel=1', NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_SEED=42, PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1) and no additional flags.
single_causal_change: One optimizer-implementation change confined to train.py: when the new module-level toggle USE_MUON_OWNER_COMPUTE (default True; env NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_MUON_OWNER_COMPUTE='0' disables; CLI --muon-owner-compute/--no-muon-owner-compute) is on and torch.distributed world_size > 1, MuonAdamW._muon_step executes the SAME arithmetic as the existing compiled _muon_math but split at the Newton-Schulz call: (pre) momentum/Nesterov update producing the NS input on every rank exactly as today; (ns) the Newton-Schulz orthogonalization runs on every rank only for a contiguous owned slice of each same-shape batch (rank r owns indices [r*per_rank, min((r+1)*per_rank, n)) with per_rank = ceil(n/world_size); the local stack has static shape [per_rank, *shape], unowned slots are filled with a copy of the batch's first matrix and discarded), then ONE torch.distributed all_gather of the local result stacks, concatenated in rank order and sliced to the first n entries, reconstructs the full orthogonalized batch; (post) the existing second-moment normalization, LR/weight-decay scaling and weight update run on every rank exactly as today on the reconstructed batch. Batches with n < 2 are not partitioned. The selected NS backend (plain / --compile-muon / --nki-muon precedence), momentum buffer layout, second-moment state, optimizer state/checkpoint format, gradient all-reduce, clipping, AdamW/ngram-ve optimizers, schedules, model, data, seed, evaluator, launch shape and environment are untouched. With the toggle off or world_size == 1 the original _muon_math path executes unchanged. Full-run classification vs same-host pinned control (trn21 2071 / 1.005734; trn22 2076 / 1.005967) in order: (1) HALT-INERT if static inspection finds NS already partitioned across ranks (no patch, no run); (2) HALT-NUMERICS if the smoke's one-time 'muon_owner_check' log line reports max_abs_diff > 1e-3 * max_abs_ref for any batch (partition changed the math), or smoke causality_passed is False; (3) CONFOUNDED-SHORT if full-run steps < 90% of same-host control (<1864 trn21, <1869 trn22); (4) FALSIFIED-INERT if steps within +/-1% of control (redundant NS is not a measurable cost at this model size); (5) SUCCESS if steps >= +2% of control and public_val_bpb < same-host control by >= 0.001; (6) FALSIFIED-QUALITY if steps >= +2% and public_val_bpb >= control; (7) INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (including +1..2% steps, or +2% steps with gain < 0.001). If steps exceed +10% (>2278 trn21, >2283 trn22) the verdict is still assigned by (5)-(7) on the fixed-budget public_val_bpb, and the Analyst additionally records the muon_owner_check line and the smoothed training-loss log at the control's final step count as attribution notes only (they are not validation BPB and do not alter the verdict).
